user.title: Connect your H700 SMART over Wi-Fi
user.description: Enter the device's LAN address, Tuya device ID, and local key. The connection goes directly to the Boneco; no cloud account is used.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read an H700 SMART at this address. Check the address, device ID, and local key. If necessary, close the Boneco mobile app and retry.
error.invalid_input: Enter a host, device ID, and a local key containing exactly 16 bytes.
